summary: Tested GDPR cookie consent banner for 4Luis platform. All 12 tests passed successfully - banner display, buttons, settings panel, localStorage persistence, and animation working correctly.
passed_tests: Cookie banner appears on first visit (after clearing localStorage key '4luis_cookie_consent')
Cookie banner shows cookie illustration image with alt text 'Cookie a sonhar'
Cookie banner text mentions 'cookies' and '4Luis' is highlighted in <strong> tag
Cookie banner has 'Aceitar' and 'Configurar' buttons with correct data-testid attributes
Clicking 'Configurar' opens settings panel with 3 categories (Essenciais, Analiticos, Marketing)
Essential cookies checkbox is always checked AND disabled (cannot be unchecked)
Analytics and Marketing toggles are functional (can be toggled on/off)
Clicking 'Guardar preferencias' saves custom preferences to localStorage and hides banner
Clicking 'Aceitar' saves consent with all cookies=true and hides banner
Banner does NOT reappear on subsequent page loads after accepting
Banner z-index is 9999 (high enough to appear above sticky elements)
Consent expiration set to 180 days (~6 months as required)
Banner is fixed at bottom of page (bottom-0) with slide-up animation via Framer Motion
critical_code_review_comments: CookieConsent component is well-structured with proper separation of concerns
localStorage read/write with expiration check is correctly implemented
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Framer Motion animation provides smooth user experience
z-index 9999 is appropriate for cookie banner overlay
seed_data_creation: None - used localStorage.removeItem() to simulate first visit
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie consent banner fully implemented and working. Uses localStorage key '4luis_cookie_consent' to store preferences. To test: clear localStorage.removeItem('4luis_cookie_consent') and reload page. Banner appears after 1.5s delay. Three cookie categories: Essential (always true, disabled), Analytics, Marketing. 'Aceitar' sets all to true. 'Guardar preferencias' saves custom selection. Consent expires after ~6 months (180 days).

cookie_banner_display.animation: slide-up from bottom via Framer Motion

aceitar_button.action: Saves all cookies as true, hides banner
